hero.researchSummary: I'm an MS Artificial Intelligence researcher at PAF-IAST (CGPA 4.00/4.00) and a Research Engineer at the Sino-Pak Centre of Artificial Intelligence (SPCAI). I build weakly-supervised and uncertainty-aware deep learning systems for high-stakes medical imaging, and co-authored a Scopus Q1 peer-reviewed publication in Frontiers in Health Services (PR-AUC 0.777). I am actively seeking and available for a PhD position (Fall 2025 / Fall 2026) in NLP and large language models, especially low-resource and multilingual NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, and trustworthy AI.
hero.industrySummary: I'm an AI engineer and machine learning researcher who ships production ML systems end to end: from processing 678,881 insurance-claims records (Scopus Q1, PR-AUC 0.777) and large RSNA DICOM CT scans with calibrated uncertainty to deploying conversational LLMs and web applications. Having supervised 150+ student engineering projects at PAF-IAST, I am actively open and available for AI/ML engineering, applied research, and consulting roles.

about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I work at the intersection of medical imaging, applied machine learning, and language models. At the Sino-Pak Centre of Artificial Intelligence (SPCAI) and PAF-IAST in Pakistan, I develop two-stage deep learning pipelines for intracranial hemorrhage localization on RSNA DICOM scans and teach undergraduate computer science and AI laboratories in Python.
about.paragraph2: My bachelor's thesis on predicting healthcare insurance claim denials grew into a peer-reviewed article in Frontiers in Health Services (Scopus Q1), evaluated on 678,881 U.S. claim lines. As a native speaker of Pashto and Dari who also works in English and Urdu, I am preparing for PhD research in low-resource and multilingual NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, and calibrated uncertainty quantification for trustworthy language models.
about.factCredentialsValue: MS AI CGPA 4.00/4.00 · Scopus Q1 Author (PR-AUC 0.777)

researchPage.heading: Research
researchPage.intro: Multilingual AI researcher (native Pashto and Dari, fluent English and Urdu) with hands-on experience in weakly-supervised deep learning, LLM-based applications and uncertainty-aware models for high-stakes decision support. Target PhD areas: natural language processing and large language models, especially low-resource and multilingual NLP, retrieval-augmented generation, and trustworthy / explainable AI — carrying over calibrated uncertainty quantification and weak supervision from current work to make language models more reliable in real deployments.
